comment: AI attack agent conformance (sdk/rasp/README.md "AI attack agents"). Written by hand from the contract; the generator only expands repeated steps. config: the attackAgents value and what it reads as. clientKey/userKey: the client key of an address or a user id (null: none). fingerprint: lower-case request headers and {kind,id} or null. oast: a request value and the domain entry found, or null. sequences: steps run through one fresh tracker in block mode with the defaults overridden by the sequence's config; a step without headers sends a browser User-Agent (defaultHeaders); expect.deter: the request gets the deter response; expect.mark: {kind, reason} the step marks (the kind the client has after it), or null. Decoy steps skip the before-handler check and are scored as decoy hits. clientTypeRules: a Defend or security rule naming client types matches a classified client (clientType null: not classified); scanner and ai_attack_agent are subtypes of unverified_automation, so a rule naming unverified_automation matches all three, while a rule naming scanner or ai_attack_agent matches only that type.
